t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The advice suggestion I pay attention to the patterns of which gnomes seem to be the most valuable and gave the most rewards. So which colour seemed more generous and follow the pattern and also to pay attention to the multiplyer at the beggining

vb_textbox.text: Look for patterns from the previous rounds, pay attention to which gnome gives you the highest reward based on their colour, hat etc and repeat that. It does change though so once you are no longer getting the most mushrooms try the other gnomes.
